coverage_gaps.reason: Every source job/matrix is accounted in workflow_jobs, but unmapped validation, build, command, publisher and orchestration jobs remain explicit profile-contract gaps; a matrix snapshot is not expanded variant coverage or successful execution. Existing generic profiles are diagnostic, not proof of workflow parity.

Exact Linux/macOS configure and primary memberships are authored; hosted 8a configure audits exposed missing linked-source/test-input edges now repaired per-check from retained evidence. The three legacy exclusions remain not_executed, generic exclusion admission and separate audit/fuzz phases are pending. Fresh exact-source postbuild headers/runtime audits and execution remain required, without new latency exclusions or threshold changes.

Separate phase application and shared Docker route exist and ten shadow workers are authored. Actual 8a x86_64 shadow configure failed missing gettext; legacy same-SHA sanitizer outcomes differ (one 120B voice LSan failure, one 65-case pass). Full production postbuild header/runtime/semantic closure and safe lifecycle execution remain unaccepted; metadata or miniatures do not establish them.
coverage_gaps.not_selected_reason: Exact configured registrations outside the legacy shared GH_SAN_TESTS set; not sanitizer members, not expected passes/skips. Generic exclusion admission remains engine-owned.

coverage_gaps.reason: Existing libgo-ci.yml macOS ASan variant excludes GoChannelStressTest for intermittent timeout. Audit-only target build is not execution; registration remains not_executed and complete_gate_eligible=false. No causal runtime fix/proof exists; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 is the effective Test-step environment on both platforms.

Initial logical inventory is non-enforcing: complete native/toolchain/sanitizer/optional profile union and exact registration membership require realization plus workflow migration. Existing legacy gates remain authoritative.
W11 measured baselines, 20 PRs, two broad runs and actual protection cutover NOT RUN; no selective production acceptance.

New actual-architecture local-only prepared011 projection; A-owned contained admission/contexts support and attested binary/context/build/toolchain receipts required. Existing Docker fixtures and09 probe not_executed, never passed. Actual prepared consumer/registration/header/runtime union and hosted/nativeMac/original Docker build custody are not established.

Five actual opt-in homed unit registrations now exist and legacy workflow exact-list/no-tests guards run them. No distinct selective profile/worker or imported raw execution receipt is claimed here. Experimental roaming/auth/identity runtimes remain off.

Worker setup, ordinary/live routing and exact Grotto profiles are under validation. No additional diagnostic nonmember list is admitted; root ASan exclusions remain unexecuted. Native Grotto extras and unverified runner/toolchain variants remain unsupported.
